tests.name: read-only pinned composition verifies actual metadata/document/observation/knowledge bytes and returns only a D2 candidate
replacing source.pdf invalidates the immutable source binding
replacing metadata.json invalidates the immutable source binding
replacing knowledge.json invalidates the immutable source binding
replacing observation.json invalidates the immutable source binding
unverifiable/missing documents, caller-substituted hashes and duplicated configured filings fail closed
missing or unapproved identity verification cannot be made authoritative by a valid PDF hash
source version replacement and undisclosed capture-set substitution cannot inherit the approved identity
symlink and relative path escapes never supply source evidence
two exact pinned authoritative captures with conflicting dates block without latest-wins replacement
documentVerifiedAt may delay effectiveKnownAt and cannot be ignored
one millisecond before boundary blocks; exact boundary passes with no implicit intraday publication time
missing required mappingKnownAt blocks rather than defaulting to capture/publication time
missing required methodologyKnownAt blocks rather than defaulting to capture/publication time
source-contract clocks and identity/method knowledge are lower bounds, never ignored for a historical cutoff
unverified VHM-style date leads and non-issuer/exchange date-only sources never qualify
source identity must be independently approved with exact immutable binding, not granted by D2 semantics
conflicting independently bound publication dates block; no latest-wins choice is made

requirements: Actual document bytes hash equals exact independently approved identity binding
Metadata/observation/knowledge bytes match configured immutable pins
Exact source version/hash and publication contract hash and identity method approval binding
Exact ticker/document URL/hash and capture set, not same-host or label matching
Original public disclosure captures only; no automatic VHM lead promotion
Knowledge evidence binds exact observation, source, document, registry and mapping version
No request-supplied files, approvals or clock substitutions in pinned composition
